Support & privacy requests

Send a platform question, report an accessibility problem, ask about your data or stop optional marketing. The request is saved for review; it does not automatically delete records or change a lawn-service booking.

Do not include passwords, card numbers, access codes or identity documents. Identity verification may be necessary before personal records are disclosed or deleted.

Lawn-service concerns

Contact the operator identified on your booking for missed visits, refunds or property damage. This platform form is not an emergency channel. No response-time guarantee is established until support staffing is confirmed.
